questions.question: What is the function of "It seems/appears that..."?
options: To indicate a situation that the speaker thinks is true.
To announce an event that will happen for sure.
To express the speaker's doubts about a condition.
questions.answer: To indicate a situation that the speaker thinks is true.
questions.explanation: 課本 Explore & Discover：It seems/appears that... 用來指出說話者（依線索）認為是真的情況。

questions.explanation: It appears that S + V 可改寫為 S + appear(s) to + VR（進行式用 to be V-ing）。

questions.question: 【多選題】Which of the following sentences use the phrase correctly?
options: (A) Annie needed a hug to cheer her up.
(B) Sam asked Ada out, but she turned down him.
(C) Kelly was just about to unlock the door when she heard a bang.
(D) Mrs. Tate made a difference in my life.
(E) His grandmother passed away the house to him.
questions.explanation: (B) 代名詞要放中間：turned him down；(E) pass away 是「過世」，不接受詞（應為 passed the house on to him）。
